observations: Photo 0 shows a marine outboard/inboard-style engine assembly mounted on a base, with visible rust/dirt and exposed components.
The engine appears incomplete/partially disassembled (loose hoses/wiring, no clear protective covers).
A label/plate on the engine block is not readable in this photo.
No clear brand/model text is readable from the image.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable brand/model text (the engine plate/markings are not legible).

risks.risk: Engine condition is unknown (may be seized, missing parts, or not serviceable). Photos show heavy grime/rust and exposed/loose components.
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least cranking with RPM) plus a short clip showing smooth idle and no abnormal smoke.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs overhaul.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged components (cooling parts, fuel system, wiring harness, alternator/starter, belts/hoses) cannot be confirmed from one angle.
risks.proof: Photo set of: full engine from both sides, close-ups of fuel injection/pump, alternator/starter, cooling water pump/impeller area, and wiring connections.

risks.risk: Model mismatch risk (seller may be naming a different Detroit Diesel series).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the engine data plate/serial plate and casting/model markings (sharp, readable).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest plausible category for an unknown marine diesel engine.

risks.risk: Marine readiness risk (gearbox/prop shaft coupling, mounts, and seawater cooling setup may be missing or mismatched).
risks.proof: Photos of the gearbox, coupling, prop shaft alignment/mounts, and seawater cooling plumbing; plus a test run in a tank/with load if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engine-only without confirmed marine integration.

proof_requests: Clear, readable close-up of the engine data/serial plate (model and serial number).
Video of cranking and start (or proof of last run) showing RPM and smoke behavior.
Photos of both sides of the engine with all major components visible (starter/alternator, fuel system, cooling water pump area, belts/hoses).
Photos of gearbox/coupling/prop shaft and any marine mounting parts.
response.reason: From photo 0, the engine’s exact model cannot be read and its working condition is not verifiable remotely; the visible grime/rust and exposed parts mean the worst-case (needs overhaul or not working) pricing applies until proof is provided.
